bundles.rationale: The positive ambiguity rule applies because the speaker expressly says two concepts are being confused. The default of none is displaced by that explicit defect cue, and attribution-error is excluded because no view or category is assigned to the wrong source or object.

bundles.evidenceText: you're confusing causation and control in the following way
bundles.rationale: The positive priority rule assigns a direct attack to the attacked central sourcehood bridge: the response disputes that causation establishes the relevant lack of control. The default narrower subsidiary route applies only when no central bridge is advanced, and alternatives is excluded because self-control is used to rebut the central bridge, not independently support forward-looking responses.

bundles.evidenceText: libertarian free will doesn't matter at all because having it wouldn't give you responsibility
bundles.rationale: The positive rule selects the narrower subsidiary indeterminacy bridge because the move independently argues that libertarian freedom would not supply responsibility. The default is the narrower supported subsidiary tier when no central or motion bridge is established; central sourcehood is excluded because the move does not argue that beyond-control factors defeat sourcehood.
